transport: POST JSON { action, payload, token }. ANYONE_ANONYMOUS is only the web app transport. It is not a data grant. Missing token fails closed except login.
isolation: Effective Sheet and Drive root must equal 1nTL99h2NBtPvPqaccwWXARF6Cc0JOG3B4PMqrGFBIdQ and 1pap27ixWjsIUpmIWzRI6pI0YPj_okD18 before any data read or write. A ScriptProperty override to any other id returns TARGET_MISMATCH and does not open that target. Properties are not changed or cleared. Only those two ids are returned, and only to an authenticated caller.
orders: No order sheet, id, or action. A contract is not an order. ORDER_UNSUPPORTED.
invoice: createInvoiceDraft only. Status is exactly 模拟/草稿 非正式凭证. No official number, tax, or signature. issueOfficialInvoice returns OFFICIAL_INVOICE_CLOSED.
fourStatementExport: exportFourStatementsDraft returns CSV only. PDF_UNSUPPORTED. It does not post formal books.
formalBooks: postFourStatements returns OPENING_UNCONFIRMED unless the sheet column 期初已确认 is already true. The API cannot set that flag.
